Fortran codegen nodes

Source: R/codegen-nodes.R
codegen-fnodes.Rd

Nodes after SymPy's sympy.codegen.fnodes: Program(), Module(), Subroutine() and SubroutineCall() build program units; Do() is a do loop, ArrayConstructor() an array constructor and ImpliedDoLoop() an implied do loop; GoTo() is a computed goto and FortranReturn() a return statement; fortran_use() and use_rename() are use statements (SymPy's use); Extent() is an array extent, fortran_dimension() the dimension attribute (SymPy's dimension) and fortran_array() declares an array (SymPy's array); allocated(), lbound(), ubound(), fortran_shape(), size() and fortran_reshape() call the intrinsic functions (SymPy's shape); bind_C() is the bind(C) attribute; isign(), dsign(), cmplx(), kind() and fortran_merge() (SymPy's merge) are intrinsic functions; literal_sp() and literal_dp() are single and double precision literals; sum_() and product_() are the array reductions.

Arguments

...

Arguments or fields of the node.

symbol, source, array

A symbol, an array or an expression.

dim, kind, shape, pad, order, intent, attrs, value, type, name

Optional arguments of the Fortran functions and attributes.

x, y, z

Expressions.

Value

A node or expression.

Examples

x <- Symbol("x"); i <- Symbol("i", integer = TRUE); n <- Symbol("n", integer = TRUE)
fcode(Do(list(AddAugmentedAssignment(x, i)), i, 1, n), source_format = "free")
#> [1] "do i = 1, n\n   x = x + i\nend do"
fcode(isign(1, x), source_format = "free")
#> [1] "isign(1, x)"
